package.description: 本地优先的 AI 学习工作区，整合学习目标、课程讲义、资料资源、任务计划、专注计时与学习记录，借助 AI 提供个性化教学、路径规划与学习反馈。

en-US.description: A local-first AI learning workspace that brings study goals, course handouts, resources, task plans, focus timers, and learning records into one platform, with AI-powered personalized teaching, path planning, and learning feedback.
en-US.longDescription: StudiumX is a desktop application centered on the learning workspace, putting AI-assisted teaching, study plans, focus tasks, a resource library, and learning analytics into one local workflow. Study goals, course handouts, trusted resources, and learning records live in your own workspace instead of being replaced by ordinary chat history. It offers ongoing AI teaching conversations, a study planner and focus workbench, resource and course management, and configurable model providers with MCP extension support. Local-first with explicit authorization: workspace shell access is not enabled by default, no telemetry is uploaded by default, and tools that write, write externally, or require privileged operations all go through effect classification and approval policies.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 学习工作区，整合学习目标、课程讲义、资料资源、任务计划、专注计时与学习记录，借助 AI 提供个性化教学、路径规划与学习反馈。
zh-CN.longDescription: StudiumX 是一个以学习工作区为中心的桌面应用，将 AI 辅助教学、学习计划、专注任务、资源库和学习分析放入同一个本地工作流；学习目标、课程讲义、可信资源与学习记录保存在你自己的工作区中，而不是被普通聊天记录替代。支持持续的 AI 教学对话、学习计划与专注工作台、资源与课程管理，以及可配置的模型提供商与 MCP 扩展接入。本地优先、显式授权：不默认启用工作区 shell，不默认上传遥测数据；涉及写入、外部写入和特权操作的工具都要经过 effect 分类与审批策略。
zh-CN.name: StudiumX
